pairs.prompt_text:
Very thorough exploration of external dependencies and data flow in tutors-apps. I need to understand:

1. How Supabase is used — find all calls to supabase client, what tables are queried, what data shapes come back. Check `src/lib/services/community/utils/supabase-client.ts` and any other supabase references.
2. How PartyKit/PartySocket is used — the WebSocket message formats, room names, event structures
3. How course data is fetched — the `tutors.json` fetch pattern, URL construction, response shapes
4. The Auth.js integration — `hooks.server.ts`, auth routes, session shape
5. How markdown/Shiki processing works — `src/lib/services/markdown/`
6. Any environment variables used (`$env/static/public`, `.env.example`)

This is needed to understand what needs mocking in tests vs what can be tested with real data. Report the data shapes/contracts for each external boundary.
pairs.response_text: I'll start by exploring the repository structure and finding all relevant files for each external dependency area. Now let me find the community types, the tutors.json fetch pattern, analytics service, and additional files. Now let me check the `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` references, the auth routes, and any session-related code. Now let me look at the `@tutors/tutors-time-lib` to understand what it does, and look at one more area - how data flows through routes. Let me look at the time lib usage more deeply and the LLM route. Now let me get the remaining pieces - the `tutors-time-lib` and `tutors-model-lib` type definitions from node_modules to understand the data shapes. No `node_modules` installed. Let me check if there are type declarations elsewhere or in lock file for the shape info. Let me also check the live route page.ts and the auth route for complete coverage. Now I have a thorough understanding of all external dependencies. Let me send the final report. The analysis is complete. I have delivered a comprehensive report covering all six areas of external dependencies with their exact data shapes, file locations, and guidance on what needs mocking versus what can use real data in tests.
